title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Named public destinations on the Western Avenue, 111th Street, Seeley Avenue, and 87th Street corridors near Saint Xavier University.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Woods Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Use the visitor center as a clearly marked starting point for a daytime walk; the Forest Preserves map places it within Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed trailhead landmark in Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map labels the Dan Ryan Woods Visitor Center on the Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Athletic Fields Map
cards.access_notes: Use during posted preserve hours; follow onsite trail and facility signage.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Sledding Hill
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Locate the named Sledding Hill on the preserve map before heading out, and use it only when seasonal conditions and posted rules allow.
cards.short_summary: A specifically labeled outdoor feature in the woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map identifies a Dan Ryan Sledding Hill within Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Picnic Groves Map
cards.access_notes: Seasonal use; check conditions and obey posted preserve rules.

cards.title: Dan Ryan Woods Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor near 87th Street
cards.notes: Use the pavilion as an easy landmark for finding the central grove area, then continue on designated paths rather than cutting across grounds.
cards.short_summary: A named pavilion within the Dan Ryan Woods map area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserves of Cook County map labels the Dan Ryan Woods Pavilion in Dan Ryan Woods.
cards.source_title: Dan Ryan Woods Athletic Fields Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to preserve rules and any reserved-event activity.

cards.title: Walker Branch
cards.subtitle: West 110th Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a library stop around its current branch schedule, and take time to view the historic exterior before heading along the 110th Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A historic Chicago Public Library branch serving nearby south-side communities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Public Library says Walker Branch serves Beverly, Morgan Park, Mount Greenwood, West Beverly, and West Pullman, and its exterior dates to 1890.
cards.access_notes: Check the branch location page for current hours and program availability.

cards.title: Beverly Branch
cards.subtitle: 95th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the branch’s location page to time a visit, then pair a library stop with a walk along the 95th Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named Chicago Public Library branch on the Beverly corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Public Library maintains a current location page for its Beverly Branch.
cards.access_notes: Check the official location page for current hours, services, and programs.

cards.title: Ridge Historical Society
cards.subtitle: Seeley Avenue corridor at 106th Street
cards.notes: Visit during the society’s listed public hours to see local-history exhibits, and confirm any holiday exceptions before making the Seeley Avenue trip.
cards.short_summary: A local-history stop with changing exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Ridge Historical Society lists its address as 10621 S. Seeley Avenue and describes an exhibit on the Ridge Historic District.
cards.access_notes: The society lists public visits Tuesday and Sunday, 1–4 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Beverly Arts Center
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at Western Avenue
cards.notes: Check the center’s event calendar before going, then use its 111th Street location as a corridor anchor for an arts-focused outing.
cards.short_summary: A named arts venue on the 111th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Chicago public meeting notice identifies Beverly Arts Center at 2407 W. 111th Street.
cards.source_title: Community Commission for Public Safety and Accountability Meeting Minutes
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticket requirements vary; consult the arts center’s current calendar.

cards.title: Kennedy (Dennis) Park
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor at 113th Street
cards.notes: Use the park’s paths, courts, or fieldhouse area during open hours, and check the Park District page for the facilities operating that day.
cards.short_summary: A City park with paths, courts, and recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Kennedy (Dennis) Park at 11320 S. Western Ave. and identifies paths, courts, fields, and a fieldhouse among its facilities.
cards.access_notes: The Park District lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; individual facilities and programs vary.

cards.title: Mount Greenwood Park
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at 37th Avenue
cards.notes: Choose a listed facility such as the playground, tennis court, or paths, and verify seasonal programs before using the 111th Street park.
cards.short_summary: A large public park with multiple documented recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Mount Greenwood Park at 3721 W. 111th St. and documents playground, tennis, fieldhouse, pool, and other facilities.
cards.access_notes: The Park District lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; seasonal facilities may differ.

cards.entity_name: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences
cards.title: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor at 39th Avenue
cards.notes: Use the public 111th Street frontage as a recognizable corridor landmark; do not enter school grounds unless you have a permitted school-related reason.
cards.short_summary: A public magnet high school dedicated to agricultural education.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences identifies its campus at 3857 W. 111th Street and states that students study agriculture.
cards.source_title: Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences: Mission and Vision
cards.access_notes: School buildings and grounds are not general public-access destinations; view from public rights-of-way unless authorized.
